name: apiosk
description: Find data sources, plan priced data requests, and retrieve approved source-backed results through Apiosk.

interface.shortDescription: Find sources and retrieve verified data
interface.longDescription: Apiosk browses published data sources, plans a data request with one total price ceiling, and runs it after the person approves within their connected account's spending limits. Results come back source-backed, with saved evidence you can recover without buying again.
defaultPrompt: Show me which company-data sources Apiosk has.
